mapper.select: SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, s.contact_name, s.phone AS supplier_phone, s.address AS supplier_address, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category AS product_category, p.unit_price AS product_price FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN supplier_product sp ON sp.supplier_id = s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sp.product_id ORDER BY s.supplier_id, p.product_id

SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, s.contact_name, s.phone AS supplier_phone, s.address AS supplier_address, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category AS product_category, p.unit_price AS product_price FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN supplier_product sp ON sp.supplier_id = s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sp.product_id WHERE s.supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY p.product_id
